edges.hint_forward: Walk straight through the main entrance gate into the covered garage area
edges.hint_backward: Walk through the garage corridor towards the outdoor entrance gate

edges.hint_forward: Walk straight past the parked scooters towards the lift lobby at the end
edges.hint_backward: Walk straight away from the elevator down the parking passage

edges.hint_forward: Take the lift up to floor 3
edges.hint_backward: Take the lift down to the ground floor

edges.hint_forward: Walk through the glass door into the open reception lounge
edges.hint_backward: Pass through the glass door into the elevator lobby

edges.hint_forward: Walk past the sofa lounge down the corridor; the meeting room is on your right
edges.hint_backward: Walk back along the hallway towards the reception sofas

edges.hint_forward: Continue along the hallway past the yellow pillar to the washroom doors on the right wall
edges.hint_backward: Turn left past the yellow pillar and head back towards the Tesla meeting room

edges.hint_forward: Continue past the photo wall towards the water cooler and pantry entrance
edges.hint_backward: Walk back down the corridor toward the washroom doors

edges.hint_forward: Walk past the water cooler; the glass Robotics Lab is directly ahead on the right
edges.hint_backward: Walk back towards the pantry doorway and water dispenser

edges.hint_forward: Walk forward into the open seminar seating and stage area
edges.hint_backward: Walk away from the stage towards the glass-walled Robotics Lab

edges.hint_forward: Walk behind the stage and exit through the glass door into the stairwell
edges.hint_backward: Enter through the glass door into the seminar room

edges.hint_forward: Walk up the stairs to reach the 4th floor landing
edges.hint_backward: Walk down the stairs to the 3rd floor exit door
